intro: Klaven Mortwake's Journal is an intelligence report recovered by SI:7 operatives from the Defias tower in northeastern Westfall. Kept secured inside a chest shipped out of Duskwood, it details the Brotherhood's covert attempts to brew alchemical concoctions capable of reanimating the dead.

p: Master Mathias Shaw, leader of Stormwind's intelligence service, prioritized the recovery of Mortwake's journal to piece together the Brotherhood's wider web of alliances. The notes confirm not only dark experiments in reanimation but also the illicit logistical support connecting Duskwood, the Venture Company, and the Defias. For rogue operatives in service to the crown, the recovery of this dark research marks the pivotal transition into mastering the art of poisons.
